text:
Theo: Heads-up 	6 invoicing run run_2026_04_07_02 produced a set of invoices with missing prorated-seat lines and several duplicate PDFs. opening thread to triage.
Maya: thanks. any sample invoice ids or accounts?
Theo: samples: INV-ARC-0601 (acct-archon), INV-CLD-211 (acct-cloudly), INV-FAE-077 (acct-faethr). customers report missing the seat-proration table and receiving two attachments.
Sasha: I pulled the generator logs. We have partial writes when the aggregation stage times out followed by retries that don't include idempotency_key. that yields a partial invoice object + a second PDF write. snippet:
```
2026-04-07T07:05:12Z ERROR invoice_agg: Timeout invoice=INV-ARC-0601
2026-04-07T07:05:13Z WARN queue: requeued job=63288 idempotency_key=null
2026-04-07T07:05:15Z INFO pdf_store: wrote tmp/inv_INV-ARC-0601_partial.pdf
```
Ibrahim: collections hold applied for the flagged accounts. support ticket FIN-10502 opened by Cloudly at 07:12 UTC.
Lena: finance ballpark exposure?
Theo: quick look ~ $1,070 (proration + one onboarding fee). will confirm after we enumerate full list.
Sasha: proposed fix: 1) ensure idempotency_key is threaded through aggregation -> render -> store, 2) make PDF writes atomic (tmp + rename), 3) add dedupe check in pdf-store based on idempotency_key, 4) run a targeted backfill to regenerate affected invoices. estimate ~75-120m including backfill.
Maya: please pause nightly runner till fix is live.
Theo: paused invoice-runner on batch09: `systemctl stop invoice-nightly`.
ops-bot: Deploy started for branch billing/idempotency-render-fix -> staging
Sasha: ran dry-run backfill: `python tools/invoice_backfill.py --run run_2026_04_07_02 --dry-run` -> found 36 invoices missing lines, 9 duplicates.
Ibrahim: CS will hold replies until regen completes. offering $20 courtesy credit to affected customers.
ops-bot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/idempotency-render-fix @ 2026-04-07T09:02:11Z
Sasha: prod backfill finished: regenerated 36 invoices, deduped 9 duplicates, uploaded corrected PDFs to invoice-store and queued resend. summary:
```
backfill_summary: regenerated=36, deduped=9, duration=31m
```
Lena: finance preparing credit memos ~ $1,050. I'll attach approval and post journals after CS confirms sends.
Maya: CS to send corrected invoices this afternoon with credit applied. template posted in #support. owners: Sasha (fix + backfill), Ibrahim (CS), Lena (finance). please add postmortem when incident closed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
